title: {{TITLE}} (WideMess game made from the devkit's template)
description: A WideMess game (BrokenNes's fantasy console, docs/projects/widemess-spec.md), made by 'brokendev new widemess {{ID}}'. C and 65816 on PVSnesLib with the WideMess extensions (BrokenDev/widemess), built on the WideMess map into a .wms. The devkit guide: docs/projects/widemess-devkit.md.

toolchain: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 (816-tcc, 816-opt, wla-65816, wla-spc700, wlalink, snesbrr), the copy in the Super VRUN workspace (snes-stub/toolchain/pvsneslib): read, never changed

steps.name: build
steps.note: wmsbuild.ps1: the converters (wms.json's graphics and sound), 816-tcc, wla-65816, wla-spc700, wlalink on PVSnesLib's HiROM libraries, Workshop --wms-pack --map 2.

run.note: The d-pad moves the ship, A plays the effect, Start the song again.

compare.why: the pad reached the game: the ship moved

compat.what: The game on BrokenNes only: no other emulator runs WideMess (the compat column is BrokenNes's alone). game_frame is the main loop's frame counter (main.c).

checks.what: the main loop runs (its frame counter ticks)
